title: Regeneration
wikitext:
'''Regeneration''' is a form of [[recovery]] that automatically restores [[life]], [[mana]] or [[energy shield]] over time. ==Mechanics== All [[Character class|classes]] have the following base regeneration stats: {{#cargo_query: |tables = generic_stats |fields = stat_text |where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%regen%" AND value > 0 |format=ul }} ==Skill gems== {{main|List of regeneration related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of regeneration related skill gems|active_skill_gems}} ==Support gems== {{main|List of regeneration related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of regeneration related skill gems|support_skill_gems}} ==Regeneration Base items== ===Life regeneration=== Base items that affect or grant life regeneration. {{Item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.rarity="Normal" AND items.is_in_game = true AND item_stats.id LIKE "%life_regen%" |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Mana regeneration=== Base items that affect or grant mana regeneration. {{Item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.rarity="Normal" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%mana_regen%" |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Unique items== ===Life regeneration=== Unique items that affect or grant life regeneration. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= ( item_stats.id LIKE "%life_regen%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%regenerate%life%" ) AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%minion%" AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%golem%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=+x per minute |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=base_life_regeneration_rate_per_minute |stat_column2_header=+x per minute
conditional |stat_column2_stat_format=add |stat_column2_stat1_id=life_regeneration_per_minute_with_no_corrupted_equipped_items |stat_column2_stat2_id=life_regeneration_per_minute_while_moving |stat_column3_header=+x per minute
per type of charge |stat_column3_stat_format=add |stat_column3_stat1_id=life_regen_per_minute_per_endurance_charge |stat_column3_stat2_id=life_regen_per_minute_per_frenzy_charge |stat_column3_stat3_id=life_regen_per_minute_per_power_charge |stat_column4_header=x% per minute |stat_column4_stat_format=add |stat_column4_stat1_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_% |stat_column5_header=x% per minute
conditional |stat_column5_stat_format=add |stat_column5_stat1_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_when_on_chilled_ground |stat_column5_stat2_id=life_regeneration_per_minute_%_while_frozen |stat_column5_stat3_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_if_have_been_hit_recently |stat_column5_stat4_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_with_400_or_more_strength |stat_column5_stat5_id=consecrate_on_block_%_life_regen_per_minute |stat_column6_header=x% per minute
per type of charge |stat_column6_stat_format=add |stat_column6_stat1_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_frenzy_charge |stat_column6_stat2_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_power_charge |stat_column6_stat3_id=life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_endurance_charge }} * Legacy {{il|Watcher's Eye}} with "(100-140) Life Regenerated per Second while affected by Vitality" ===Minion Life regeneration=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= ( item_stats.id LIKE "%life_regen%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%regenerate%life%" ) AND ( item_stats.id LIKE "%minion%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%golem%" ) |level=1 }} ===Mana regeneration=== Unique items that affect or grant mana regeneration. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%mana_regen%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=+x per minute |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=base_mana_regeneration_rate_per_minute |stat_column1_stat2_id=local_left_ring_slot_mana_regeneration_rate_per_minute |stat_column2_header=x% rate |stat_column2_stat_format=add |stat_column2_stat1_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+% |stat_column3_header=x% rate
conditional |stat_column3_stat_format=add |stat_column3_stat1_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+%_during_flask_effect |stat_column3_stat2_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+%_while_stationary |stat_column4_header=x% rate
per type of charge |stat_column4_stat_format=add |stat_column4_stat1_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+%_per_power_charge |stat_column4_stat2_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+%_per_frenzy_charge |stat_column4_stat3_id=mana_regeneration_rate_+%_per_endurance_charge }} ===Energy shield regeneration=== Unique items that affect or grant energy shield regeneration. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%energy_shield_regen%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=x% per minute |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=base_energy_shield_regeneration_rate_per_minute_% |stat_column2_header=x% per minute
conditional |stat_column2_stat_format=add |stat_column2_stat1_id=local_right_ring_slot_base_energy_shield_regeneration_rate_per_minute_% }} ==Passive skills== There are [[passive skill]]s that grant regeneration bonuses. ===Life regeneration=== These passive skills affect life regeneration. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%" }} {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%" }} ====Life regeneration per endurance charge==== These passive skills grant additional life regeneration based on the number of [[endurance charge]]s the character has. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_endurance_charge" }} {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_endurance_charge" }} ====Minion life regeneration==== These passive skills grant additional life regeneration for [[minion]]s. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "minion_life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%" }} ====Conditional life regeneration==== {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%life_regen%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%", "life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%_per_endurance_charge", "minion_life_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%" ) }} ===Mana regeneration=== These passive skills grant increased mana regeneration rate. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "mana_regeneration_rate_+%" }} {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "mana_regeneration_rate_+%" }} ====Conditional mana regeneration==== {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%mana_regeneration_rate%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("mana_regeneration_rate_+%") }} ===Energy Shield Regeneration=== That passives affect energy shield regeneration (without [[Zealot's Oath]]): {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "base_energy_shield_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%" }} ====Conditional energy shield regeneration==== {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%energy_shield_regen%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("base_energy_shield_regeneration_rate_per_minute_%") }} ===Other passives=== {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%regen%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%life_regen%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%energy_shield_regen%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_regeneration_rate%" }} ===Keystone=== {{Query keystone passive skills |where= ( passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Regeneration%" ) }} ===Masteries=== The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Regeneration: {{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%regen%"}} ===Tattoos/Runegrafts=== {{Drop enabled item table |tables = tattoos |join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID |where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency" AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL AND items.description LIKE "%regen%" |large=1 |description=1 }} ==Version History== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * New Suffix modifiers have been added to all Armour-based Gloves, Helmets and Boots that provide increased Life Regeneration Rate. This works as a multiplier to your Life Regeneration value. Crafted modifiers have also been added. }} {{Version history table row|0.7.1| * Made life regeneration higher on items. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.10| * Nerfed mana regen by 33%. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.8| * Nerfed mana regen. * Boosted energy shield regen. }} {{Version history table row|0.5.13| * Reduced the effectiveness of life regeneration mods. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Game mechanics]]
